translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content: Ikiavɨra Itir God gavgavim isa atrivim ganɨdir ighiam
Kar Godɨn ziam fer onger akam. Devit an osiri.

content.text: Ikiavɨra Itir God, nan Ekiam mɨgɨa ghaze,
“Nɨ nan agharir guvimɨn daperagh ikɨ mangɨtɨ,
kɨ nɨn apaniba dɨkabɨragh me isɨ nɨn dafarim datɨghtɨ
me nɨn dagarimningɨn apengan ikiam.”
Ikiavɨra Itir God nɨ damightɨ,
nɨ Saionɨn nguibamɨn ikɨ gavgavir ekiam ikɨ
nguibar avɨribagh ativagh dar ganam.
God ghaze, nɨ uan apanibagh ativagham.
Nɨ uan apanibav soghamin dughiam,
nɨn gumazamiziba uaghan nɨ ko mangɨ nɨn akurvagham,
egh ia Godɨn mɨghsɨamɨn ghuavanangam.
E gari ghuariabar amariba dɨmagaribar ira azenibagh iri
da aghua dagher avɨriba iti.
Kamaghɨra, nɨ dughiabar zurara gavgavim ini mamaghɨra ikɨ,
egh gumazir igiamɨn mɨn otogham.
Ikiavɨra Itir God Akar Gavgavim nɨ koma anekɨrigha gɨfa,
egh uan nɨghnɨzim giraghan kogham.
A ghaze, “Nɨ ofa gamir gumazimɨn ikɨ mamaghɨra ikiam.
Nɨ Melkisedeghɨn mɨn ofa gamir gumazimɨn ikiam.”
Ekiam gavgavim nɨ danɨngasa nɨ ko iti.
Eghtɨ an anɨngagharir dughiam otoghtɨ
an atriviba tintinimɨn me mɨsogh me gasɨghasɨgham.
A nguazimɨn gumazamizibar arazir kuraba ikarvagh,
egh mɨdorozir danganibar a gumazir avɨribav soghtɨ me arɨmɨghiram.
An atrivir avɨriba ko mɨsogh me abɨnam.
Atrivim tuavir mɨriamɨn ivemarir daghurir dɨpabar amɨ,
egh a gavgavim inigh, uan apaniba dɨkabɨragham.
